summary: The Form 6-K filed by Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. discloses that the US FDA completed a Pre-License Inspection at its biologics manufacturing facility in Bachupally, Hyderabad from June 16-25, 2026, issuing a Form 483 with seven observations. The company states it will address these within the stipulated timeline. This is a routine regulatory update, not a special situation event. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic changes are involved. The filing serves as a disclosure to stock exchanges under Indian regulations, with no US-equivalent special situation mapping.
